read-update-pdf-metadata.title: Read and Update PDF Metadata with PdfFileInfo
read-update-pdf-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF file, read its metadata using PdfFileInfo, modify fields such as Title and Author, and save the changes back to the document.

read-pdf-author-metadata.title: Read PDF Author Metadata with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-author-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, retrieve the Author metadata, and output it to the console while handling missing files and errors.

read-pdf-title-metadata-log.title: Read PDF Title Metadata and Log It
read-pdf-title-metadata-log.description: Demonstrates how to extract the Title metadata from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and append it to a log file.

retrieve-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Retrieve PDF Keywords Metadata
retrieve-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to open a PDF file and read its Keywords metadata property, with basic error handling.

read-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Read PDF Creator Metadata with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to retrieve the Creator metadata field from a PDF without loading the entire document.

read-pdf-modification-date.title: Read PDF Modification Date with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-modification-date.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to obtain a PDF's ModDate, parse it to a DateTime, and output a formatted modification timestamp.

update-pdf-author-metadata.title: Update PDF Author Metadata using PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-author-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Author metadata of a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and save the changes to a new document.

update-pdf-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Title Metadata
update-pdf-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Title property of a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and save the changes to a new document.

set-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Set PDF Keywords Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
set-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign the Keywords metadata field of a PDF using the PdfFileInfo class, save the updated document, and verify that the value was persisted correctly.

set-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Set PDF Creator Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
set-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign a custom Creator value to a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and persist the change with SaveNewInfo.

add-custom-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom 'ProjectCode' Metadata to PDF
add-custom-metadata-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add or update a custom metadata entry named "ProjectCode" in a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save the result to a new file.

retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata (ProjectCode)
retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to read a custom metadata entry from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades without loading the entire document.

add-custom-metadata-reviewedby-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata 'ReviewedBy' to PDF
add-custom-metadata-reviewedby-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF, setting a custom metadata field using SetMetaInfo, and saving the updated document to a new file.

retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata-reviewedby.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata (ReviewedBy)
retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata-reviewedby.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to read a custom metadata entry named "ReviewedBy" from a PDF file and log it for audit purposes.

add-department-metadata-to-pdfs.title: Add Custom Metadata to Multiple PDFs using Aspose.Pdf Facades
add-department-metadata-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to loop through PDF files, add a custom "Department" metadata field with PdfFileInfo, and save the modified PDFs to an output folder.

add-custom-metadata-field-to-pdf.title: Add Custom 'Version' Metadata to PDF
add-custom-metadata-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, preserving existing metadata, and adding or updating a custom "Version" field using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

remove-custom-pdf-metadata-entry.title: Clear Custom PDF Metadata Entry
remove-custom-pdf-metadata-entry.description: Shows how to remove a specific custom metadata field from a PDF document using the Aspose.Pdf Facades API.

read-custom-pdf-metadata-existence-check.title: Read Custom PDF Metadata Key "Confidential"
read-custom-pdf-metadata-existence-check.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, checking file existence, and safely retrieving a custom metadata entry named "Confidential" from the document's Info dictionary.

add-lastupdated-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom 'LastUpdated' Metadata to PDF using Facades
add-lastupdated-metadata-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set a custom metadata field named "LastUpdated" with the current UTC timestamp on a PDF file using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades API, and then save the updated document.

update-pdf-metadata-save-new-file.title: Update PDF Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-metadata-save-new-file.description: Shows how to load a PDF, modify its Title, Author, Subject, and Keywords, and persist the changes back to the file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

load-pdf-retrieve-file-info-and-save.title: Read PDF Metadata and Add a Blank Page
load-pdf-retrieve-file-info-and-save.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve basic PDF metadata using PdfFileInfo and then add a blank page to the document with Document before saving the result.

backup-and-update-pdf-metadata.title: Backup PDFs and Update Metadata with PdfFileInfo
backup-and-update-pdf-metadata.description: Creates a backup copy of each PDF in a folder and then modifies its metadata (title, author, subject, keywords) using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFileInfo class.

audit-pdf-metadata-to-csv.title: Log Original and Updated PDF Metadata to CSV
audit-pdf-metadata-to-csv.description: Demonstrates reading PDF metadata with PdfFileInfo, updating it via Document.Info, saving the file, and writing a CSV audit of original and new values.

handle-readonly-file-errors-when-saving-.title: Handle Read‑Only Attribute When Saving PDF Metadata
handle-readonly-file-errors-when-saving-.description: Demonstrates how to modify PDF metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and handle an IOException caused by a read‑only file attribute by clearing the attribute and retrying the save operation.

update-pdf-metadata-memorystream.title: Update PDF Metadata Using MemoryStream and PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-metadata-memorystream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF into a MemoryStream, binding it to PdfFileInfo, modifying metadata fields, and saving the updated PDF.

update-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Update PDF Keywords Metadata via Stream
update-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF as a FileStream, initializing Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo with the stream, modifying the Keywords metadata, and saving the updated document.

update-pdf-author-metadata-conditional.title: Conditionally Update PDF Author Metadata
update-pdf-author-metadata-conditional.description: Shows how to read a PDF's Author metadata with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and set it only when the field is empty, then save the updated file.

list-custom-pdf-metadata-keys.title: List PDF Metadata Keys Alphabetically
list-custom-pdf-metadata-keys.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieve all metadata keys (including custom ones), sort them alphabetically, and display each key with its corresponding value.

merge-xmp-metadata-with-pdf-fileinfo.title: Merge XMP Packet with PDF Metadata using Aspose.Pdf
merge-xmp-metadata-with-pdf-fileinfo.description: Shows how to load a PDF, set standard PDF metadata, import an external XMP packet, register its namespaces, and save the combined metadata back to a new PDF file.

read-pdf-version.title: Read PDF Version Number Using Aspose.Pdf
read-pdf-version.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieving its version via the Document.Version property, and storing the value for later use.

export-pdf-metadata-to-json.title: Export PDF Metadata to JSON
export-pdf-metadata-to-json.description: The example iterates through PDF files in a folder, extracts document metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, and writes the collected information to a formatted JSON file.

import-json-metadata-to-pdf.title: Import JSON Metadata and Apply to PDFs
import-json-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to read a JSON file with metadata records and apply those fields to PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

apply-metadata-changes-to-multiple-pdfs-.title: Parallel Batch Update of PDF Metadata
apply-metadata-changes-to-multiple-pdfs-.description: Shows how to apply title, author, subject, and keywords to multiple PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and the Task Parallel Library.

thread-safe-parallel-pdf-metadata-update.title: Thread‑Safe PDF Metadata Update with PdfFileInfo
thread-safe-parallel-pdf-metadata-update.description: Demonstrates how to modify PDF metadata (Title) safely from multiple threads using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and Parallel.ForEach.

validate-set-pdf-metadata-with-regex.title: Validate and Set PDF Metadata with Regex
validate-set-pdf-metadata-with-regex.description: Demonstrates how to validate title, author, and subject strings using a regular expression before assigning them to a PDF's metadata via Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and saving the updated document.

read-pdf-metadata-with-null-handling.title: Read PDF Metadata with Null Handling
read-pdf-metadata-with-null-handling.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to read common PDF metadata fields and gracefully handle null or empty values.

update-pdf-subject-metadata.title: Update PDF Subject Metadata using PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-subject-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Subject field of a PDF's metadata using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo class and save the updated document.

set-pdf-language-property.title: Set PDF Language Property via TaggedContent
set-pdf-language-property.description: Demonstrates how to set the /Lang entry of a PDF to "en-US" using Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API and save the modified document.
